# Official asset sources

These assets are published by Palo Alto Networks and are used here as visual
identifiers for the relevant Prisma AIRS capabilities. Palo Alto Networks does
not publish a separate product logo for every sub-capability, so official
feature artwork is mapped by function instead of inventing new marks.

- `prisma-airs.svg` — Prisma AIRS standalone mark from the [AI Red Teaming product page](https://www.paloaltonetworks.com/ai-security/ai-red-teaming)
- `prisma-primary.png`, `prisma-reversed.png` — Prisma brand marks from the [Palo Alto Networks brand page](https://www.paloaltonetworks.com/company/brand)
- `gateway-*.svg` — official feature artwork from the [AI Gateway product page](https://www.paloaltonetworks.com/ai-security/ai-gateway)
- `runtime-*.svg` — official feature artwork from the [AI Runtime Security product page](https://www.paloaltonetworks.com/ai-security/ai-runtime-security)
- `runtime-platform.svg` is reused for the Endpoint Security node representing the documented [Cortex Agentic Endpoint Security and Prisma AIRS Runtime Security integration](https://www.paloaltonetworks.com/blog/ai-security/securing-the-ai-coding-frontier-prisma-airs-agentic-endpoint-security/)
- `redteam-*.svg` — official feature artwork from the [AI Red Teaming product page](https://www.paloaltonetworks.com/ai-security/ai-red-teaming)
- `model-*.svg` — official feature artwork from the [AI Model Security product page](https://www.paloaltonetworks.com/ai-security/ai-model-security)
- `model-manufacturing.svg` identifies the parent [AI Supply Chain Security](https://docs.paloaltonetworks.com/prisma-airs/ai-supply-chain-security/ai-supply-chain-security) node; `model-inspection.svg` identifies its Model Security child.
- `model-visibility.svg` is reused for the [AI Skill Security (Preview)](https://docs.paloaltonetworks.com/prisma-airs/ai-supply-chain-security/ai-supply-chain-security/ai-skill-security) child because Palo Alto Networks does not publish a separate downloadable Skill Security mark.
- `gateway-identity.svg` identifies the parent [AI Agent Identity](https://docs.paloaltonetworks.com/prisma-airs/ai-agent-identity) pillar because the available official artwork best represents agent identity and posture.
- `runtime-visibility.svg` and `gateway-controls.svg` identify the SaaS Agent Security and MCP Security children under AI Agent Identity; Palo Alto Networks does not publish separate downloadable marks for those documentation sections.

All product names and marks remain the property of their respective owner.
